sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which of these objects is used in the game of Pitthou?
options: B) Seven flat stones and a soft ball
questions.answer: B) Seven flat stones and a soft ball

questions.question_text: What should you do immediately if you get a scrape that is bleeding on the field?
options: B) Wash it with dirty water
C) Tell a teacher and use a first-aid kit to clean and bandage it
questions.answer: C) Tell a teacher and use a first-aid kit to clean and bandage it

questions.question_text: When running, how should your arms move?
options: C) Swinging back and forth in rhythm with your legs
D) Held straight up in the air
questions.answer: C) Swinging back and forth in rhythm with your legs

questions.question_text: In Yoga, why is it important to focus your eyes on a single point during Vrikshasana (Tree Pose)?
options: B) To help maintain physical balance
C) To see who is watching
D) To stretch the eye muscles
questions.answer: B) To help maintain physical balance

questions.question_text: What happens in a game when the set 'duration' is over?
options: B) The game ends and the team with the most points wins
questions.answer: B) The game ends and the team with the most points wins

questions.question_text: Which of these is the best example of a manipulative movement?
How should you care for sports equipment like a racket or bat?
options: A) Leave them in the rain
B) Throw them on the ground when finished
C) Clean them and put them away in their proper place
D) Use them to hit stones
questions.answer: C) Clean them and put them away in their proper place

questions.question_text: If a teammate is running slower than the rest, what should the team do?
options: A) Exclude them from the game
B) Encourage them and adjust the pace to help them
D) Ask them to sit down
questions.answer: B) Encourage them and adjust the pace to help them

questions.question_text: In Kabaddi, what must the defending team do to get the raider 'out'?
options: B) Catch and hold the raider until they lose their breath/chant
C) Throw a ball at the raider
questions.answer: B) Catch and hold the raider until they lose their breath/chant

questions.question_text: Which direction should you aim your foot when kicking a ball to a teammate?
Explain why keeping a good posture during play is important.
questions.answer: Good posture helps prevent back and muscle injuries, allows you to breathe properly, and gives you better balance while moving.

questions.question_text: What is the primary role of a 'chaser' in Kho-Kho?
questions.answer: The chaser's role is to run, navigate around the poles, and tag the opposing team's active runners to get them 'out'.

questions.question_text: Name two types of throws used in sports.
questions.answer: Two types are the overhand throw (for distance) and the underhand throw (for short accuracy).

questions.question_text: How do you practice simple meditation (Dhyana) in Yoga Sadhana?
questions.answer: Sit comfortably with a straight back, close your eyes, breathe naturally, and focus your mind purely on the feeling of your breath.

questions.question_text: What does a 'foul' in a football game mean?
questions.answer: A foul means a player broke a rule, such as pushing an opponent or touching the ball with their hands.

sections.section_name: Section C - Sports Mechanics & Fill in the Blanks

questions.question_text: Fill in the blanks: a) Sweating during play means your body is losing ______. b) When striking a ball, use a ______ swing mechanism. c) Before doing heavy Asanas, we must perform a ______.
questions.answer: a) water (or hydration), b) smooth/timed, c) warm-up

questions.question_text: Match the action to its skill category: 1) Catching a baseball 2) Galloping across the field 3) Twisting the waist || A) Non-locomotor B) Manipulative C) Locomotor
During team selection, one student is always left out because they cannot run very fast. You are the team captain today. How do you resolve this ethical dilemma?
questions.answer: As captain, I would pick the student for my team immediately. I would assign them a role where running isn't the only important skill, like being a catcher or a thrower, ensuring they feel included and valued in the game.

questions.question_text: You are organizing a game of Pitthou. Write down a 3-step safety and equipment checklist before the game begins.
questions.answer: 1) Check that the 7 stones are flat and have no sharp edges. 2) Ensure the ball used is soft (like a tennis or rubber ball) so it doesn't hurt anyone. 3) Clear the playing area of any dangerous objects like broken glass or large rocks.
